scope: Audited retrospective evaluation; original inputs are read-only and outputs separate.
selection_loss: pooled inner-validation mean squared error; no outer-test outcome is used for selection
window_rule: Reference-coordinate windows: subdivide original at-most-25-SNP/50kb windows for scales 5/10, retain for 25, merge two/four consecutive same-chromosome windows for 50/100. Boundaries are outcome-independent. Mean dosage weights all retained SNPs equally within each window.
fair_ablation: Use exactly the legacy 202747 marker indices and 83-accession allele indicators for SNP, regional linear and local Gaussian models; fixed reference window 25. Match the legacy folds and hyperparameter choices where reproducing old numbers, and distinguish this ablation from fully inductive evaluation.
strict_preprocessing: Every inner/outer training split estimates the allele convention, retains biallelic polymorphic markers with training MAF>0.05, and estimates feature scales. SNP/linear/local kernels all use the same retained indicators. Constant regional features are removed by training-only checks. Centering and trace normalization use only training kernels and are frozen for the cross kernel.
additional_comparisons: Strong baselines and sensitivity analyses are not selected post hoc according to significance.
metrics: calibration slope: observed regressed on predictions
uncertainty: Repeat metrics describe split variability, not independent biological replications. Report paired differences and conditional accession/ancestry-cluster bootstrap intervals with explicit limitations; retain Nadeau-Bengio only as approximate sensitivity. Add a training-refitted robustness analysis rather than treating saved predictions as covering training-set uncertainty. Phenotype signal tests are distinct from model-superiority tests.
external_policy: Freeze all model selection using the training cohort only. Audit overlaps by canonical genotype column/ecotype ID, not names alone. Do not optimize models on external outcomes.
robustness: Retain all accessions in the main analysis. Prespecified sensitivity leaves out the single maximum-DSDS50 accession and reports its identity; do not search for favorable exclusions.
disclosure: Retrospective evaluation protocol, not prospective preregistration; all completed outcomes are reported.
